verdicts.reason: A is broken: the white headline sits right on top of the lime circle and the shoe, so it is barely readable; the logo overlaps the top of the circle; and the bottom ~45% of the canvas is empty purple. The NEW VIDEO badge has also been moved down under the subcopy, as if it were the button. B is a clean vertical stack (logo and badge, then headline, then circle and shoe, then subcopy) with nothing colliding. Its flaws are small: the shoe nearly touches the edges of the circle, 'Full review inside.' is small and pushed close to the bottom edge, and the badge sits a little tight to the top right corner.
